name: smwgraphics-sloped-and-cracked-cement
title: Sloped and Cracked Cement
description:
It's the cement we all know and love but now carved into slopes!

These graphics were drawn for my 2021 KLDC submission with cracked and mossy cement block variations too, so I've included those as well.

Uses vanilla palettes, but the green in the second half of palette 4 that the moss uses is a bit bright so I recommend changing it.

This assets takes up half of a graphics file and depends on the original cement block graphics for filler.
